scored_papers.title: Resolving a Clumpy Disk Wind in 4U 1957+115 with XRISM
scored_papers.abstract: We present a high-resolution XRISM/Resolve observation of the persistent black hole candidate 4U 1957+115, revealing the first detection of an intrinsic disk wind in this source. The absorption is dominated by highly ionized Fe XXV and Fe XXVI and varies substantially throughout the observation, becoming prominent during the final $\sim40$ ks despite a modest decrease of only $\sim5$--$10\%$ in source flux. The observed evolution of the absorption cannot be explained solely by ionization changes driven by the modest continuum variability, favoring an inhomogeneous outflow with evolving line-of-sight properties. Time-resolved spectroscopy reveals substantially narrower absorption features in shorter intervals, with the inferred turbulent velocity decreasing from $\sim350~{\rm km/s}$ in the longer integration to $\lesssim70~{\rm km/s}$ in the shortest selections. This suggests that the broader absorption profiles measured over longer integrations may result, at least in part, from averaging over an evolving wind rather than from intrinsically larger turbulent velocities. Such time averaging can therefore affect the inferred physical properties of the wind and complicate efforts to identify its launching mechanism. Even though the wind carries only a small fraction of the radiative luminosity in kinetic form, its mass-loss rate may remain dynamically relevant. These results highlight the importance of time-resolved, high-resolution X-ray spectroscopy for characterizing the structure and variability of accretion disk winds.
scored_papers.reason: 🛰️🔭 XRISM Resolve でブラックホール候補 4U 1957+115 の円盤風を初検出！吸収が観測中に大きく変わり、長時間積分の平均が乱流速度を過大に見せる話は X 線テーマに直結✨
scored_papers.summary: Fe XXV・XXVI の吸収が強く変動し、非一様な塊状の流出を示唆。短い区間では線が細く乱流速度は ≲70 km/s。時間分解の高分解能 X 線分光の重要性を示す。
